previous.question: Should this source become a reference for Shipped, which tracks new arrivals in machine learning (open-weights releases, decision models in production, and the products built on them) from the moment they land? Include a source about a specific machine-learning release with a checkable primary source (release page, model card, repository, paper or documentation): an open-weights model; a decision model that returns typed decisions, scores or choices (such as a classifier, safety or routing model, or ranker) that is publicly usable or documented in use; an open text-to-speech model; or a real ML product or API people can use. Announcements count when the primary source is there. Exclude opinion and commentary, funding or acquisition news with no release, benchmarks or leaderboards with no new release, tutorials, and release claims with no primary source a reader can check.
